title: rate_limiter: O(n) retain() eviction scan on every check_and_consume call
description:
## What / Why
In crates/core/src/rate_limiter.rs, check_and_consume() calls state.retain(|_, entry| ...) on every single request. retain() is an O(n) full HashMap scan where n is the number of tracked IPs. For an admin server with many distinct clients, this scan runs on every request even when all clients are well within their rate limits.

## Fix
Replace the always-on retain() with a periodic eviction sweep: track last_eviction: Instant, and run retain() only when now - last_eviction > eviction_interval (e.g. 60s). This makes the common case O(1) amortized instead of O(n) per call.
